keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of a ripe rice field in the countryside of southern Vietnam, at golden hour. Close-up of several heavy golden rice panicles bending down in the center of the frame, ripe grains clearly visible. Blurred background: golden rice field, coconut palms and a distant old tiled roof. Warm sunlight from the left. Shallow depth of field. No people. Keep the panicles inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The rice has been harvested and milled. Show a top-down view of a large round dented aluminum basin filled with clear water, with many white rice grains soaking at the bottom, sitting in the center of a rustic dark wooden table. A few dry rice stalks lie on the table at the top edge. Same warm golden light from the left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same basin, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The rice grains and clear water are gone: the basin is now filled with smooth milky white rice batter. At the top edge of the frame, the lower part of a traditional grey stone hand mill is visible, with a thin stream of white rice batter flowing from it into the basin. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the basin is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a round traditional steamer pot with a white cloth stretched tightly over its mouth, and one thin round translucent sheet of steamed rice paper lies on the cloth, a little steam rising, a ladle resting next to it. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the steamer pot is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a flat woven bamboo drying rack with four round thin rice paper sheets drying side by side in the sun, the crisscross bamboo pattern pressed into them. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the drying rack is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a large white ceramic bowl with spring roll filling ingredients in separate neat piles: pink minced pork, chopped shrimp, shredded taro, shredded orange carrot, soaked glass noodles and chopped black wood ear mushroom, with one raw egg cracked on top. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same bowl, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The separate piles are gone: all the ingredients and the egg are now mixed evenly together into one filling, with bits of orange carrot and black mushroom visible, a spoon resting in the bowl. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the filling bowl is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a wooden cutting board with one round rice paper sheet, and on it one tightly rolled raw Vietnamese spring roll (cha gio), pale and neat, about the length of a finger. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same wooden board, the same top-down camera, the same table and the same light. The board is now covered with about twelve tightly rolled raw spring rolls lined up in neat rows, all the same size, no loose rice paper left. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the board of raw rolls is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a black frying pan with hot bubbling oil, with six spring rolls frying in it, turning light golden, small bubbles around them. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same top-down camera, the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera has moved a little to the right: the frying pan is now only partly visible at the left edge. In the center is a round woven bamboo basket lined with paper, full of deep golden crispy fried spring rolls with blistered skin, glistening, a little steam rising. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the same wooden table and the same warm light. The camera is a little higher and wider. In the center is a white plate of golden crispy spring rolls, some cut diagonally showing the filling, with fresh lettuce, Vietnamese herbs and cucumber slices beside them, and a small bowl of sweet and sour fish sauce with carrot and chili slices next to the plate, a pair of wooden chopsticks. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Same plate of spring rolls, same table, same warm light, but now a close-up seen from a low 45-degree side angle. In the center, two hands break one golden crispy spring roll in half, showing the hot juicy filling of pork, shrimp, carrot and noodles, steam rising, a few crispy crumbs falling. The plate and herbs are softly blurred behind. Keep the hands and the roll inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No text, no watermark.

clips.prompt: In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. In a single continuous shot, no scene cuts. Static locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom.
